title: Quaint Peruvian Duck Arroz Con Pato
description: A peppery and comforting Peruvian dish featuring duck and apricot, cooked in a traditional tajine clay vessel, this arroz con pato is a low-carb friendly meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the duck fat over medium heat and sear the duck breast until browned on all sides.
Transfer the duck to a plate and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked white rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Transfer the rice mixture to the tajine clay vessel and add the chopped apricots and browned duck breast.
Cover the vessel with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven, cooking for 25 minutes or until the rice is tender and the duck is cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
